title: KĀLA-YANTRA v3 job result, <JOB_SCRATCH>/result.json (relaunch plan v2.7 §5 job I/O, §6 job identity)
description: What a job reports about itself when it ends, written to $JOB_SCRATCH/result.json (the job reads JOB_SCRATCH from its environment). A job that ends without it is not a success: the supervisor records job_result_valid false with termination_detail no_result and exits 5; a result.json that is a symbolic link is refused unread. It is the job's own claim, never a verdict: status 'done' is not acceptance, and the tests listed are what the job says it ran. A blocked job must say why; a job that names a PR must name the head it registered for it (a verifier, surrogate or reviewer job pushes nothing and reports head_sha null; a reviewer job may carry its proposed verdict, which only the controller publishes). Shape only: that job_id and item are those of the launching job, that head_sha is the branch head and that the PR exists is not checked by this schema (the supervisor compares job_id and item; review checks the rest).

proposed_verdict.description: Reviewer jobs only, optional: the verdict the job proposes. It is a proposal; its contents are not typed here.
